product.ta-msx-3240.summary: The MSX 3240 was one of the three 32-bit models announced for the MSX 3200 family.
product.ta-msx-3240.history: Triumph-Adler offered it in March 1988 as part of the Unix range above System M32.
product.ta-msx-3240.technical.configurat: TANIX V was the range’s operating system. The contemporary trade press describes a Motorola 68020 multiprocessor platform.
product.ta-msx-3240.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-msx-3240.technical.limitation: The exact configuration of this model, its ROM and boot media remain pending.
